Grave Attendant

You made sure someone remembered the names after the mourners went home.

Whose grave do you still visit?

Rules

Type: Background. Status: Proposal. Choose one paired option; do not mix the rank from one with the card from another.

- Medicine 1 and @UUID[Compendium.heroes-of-legend.player-rules.JournalEntry.7f53902694b57ffd.JournalEntryPage.525847145a598d86]{Treat Soft Tissue}. - Life 1 and @UUID[Compendium.heroes-of-legend.player-rules.JournalEntry.85442bfefbe9d679.JournalEntryPage.3a15668fd31a6c80]{Shared Breath}.

Grant at level 0. Duplicate grants provide 1 stage DP each; never promote a rank automatically. No discipline purchases at level 0. Ancestry does not restrict this choice. Follow each card’s explicit equipment grant.

Starting coin contribution: +5 coins. See @UUID[Compendium.heroes-of-legend.player-rules.JournalEntry.0558be1f6014ee71.JournalEntryPage.880380bcd80cfec6]{starting coins}.
